data.source: Bank of Canada zero-coupon Government of Canada yields
data.sampling: last complete observation in each ISO week

models.SS_M3: joint latent-factor DNS with constant diagonal factor-innovation covariance
models.SS_M4: joint latent-factor DNS with factor-specific stochastic log variance
shared_restrictions: diagonal factor-innovation covariance conditional on volatility
models.measurement_covariance: diagonal; each variance has an independent inverse-gamma prior
models.sv_state_update: elliptical slice sampling with exact Gaussian factor-innovation likelihood

prior_calibration.factor_long_run_mean: Normal(training OLS-extracted factor mean, (2 * training factor SD)^2)
prior_calibration.factor_persistence: training OLS-centered Normal with SD 0.03, truncated to (-1, 1)
prior_calibration.log_long_run_expected_factor_variance: Normal(training OLS AR residual log mean square, SD 1)
prior_calibration.measurement_variance: InvGamma(shape=3, scale=2 * initial-window OLS reconstruction residual mean square)
notes: SS_M3 and SS_M4 share the same interpretation and priors for expected factor innovation variance.
Training OLS factors calibrate priors and initialize chains; the yield likelihood jointly infers latent factors.
The 2016-2025 forecast scores are not used to select prior hyperparameters.

mcmc.diagnostics: rank-normalized R-hat, bulk ESS, and tail ESS

gates.expansion_rule: No Canadian forecast origins before repeated synthetic recovery and initial-window diagnostics pass.
